ei.title: Daniel's Journey from Anxiety to Relief
ei.subject: 6월_2026 고1 모의고사
ei.lesson: Daniel's Journey from Anxiety to Relief

fullPassage: Daniel was on his way to the train station for a business trip. He was riding a bus when it suddenly stopped. The driver announced, "We have a mechanical problem." Daniel grew nervous about missing his train. Without hesitation, he got off the bus and took a taxi to the station. Still, he kept worrying about not making it in time. When he finally reached the station, he found out the train was delayed by ten minutes. Once he settled into his seat, he let out a long breath of relief.

questions.passage: Daniel was on his way to the train station for a business trip. He was ①<u>riding</u> a bus when it suddenly ②<u>stopped</u>. The driver ③<u>announced</u>, "We have a mechanical problem." Daniel grew ④<u>nervously</u> about missing his train. Without hesitation, he got off the bus and took a taxi to the station. Still, he kept worrying about not making it in time. When he finally reached the station, he found out the train was delayed by ten minutes. Once he settled into his seat, he let out a long breath of relief.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④ nervously → nervous: grew는 2형식 동사(become 의미)로 주격보어 자리에 형용사 nervous가 와야 한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① riding: 과거진행 was + V-ing
✅ ② stopped: 과거시제
✅ ③ announced: 과거시제
❌ ④ nervously → nervous: grew + 형용사(주격보어)

Daniel grew nervous about missing his train. Without ①<u>hesitation</u>, he got off the bus and ②<u>took</u> a taxi to the station. Still, he kept ③<u>worry</u> about not making it in time. When he finally reached the station, he found out the train was ④<u>delayed</u> by ten minutes. Once he settled into his seat, he let out a long breath of relief.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ worry → worrying: kept 뒤에 동명사(V-ing)가 와야 한다. keep + V-ing = 계속 ~하다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① hesitation: without + 명사
✅ ② took: 과거시제
❌ ③ worry → worrying: keep + V-ing
✅ ④ delayed: 과거분사(수동)

❌ ② make → making: about + V-ing (not making it in time)

det.korean: ① them → it: 앞 문장의 a bus(단수)를 받는 대명사이므로 단수 it이 와야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ④ advanced(앞당겨진) → delayed(지연된): Daniel이 걱정했으나 기차가 10분 지연되어 안도했으므로 delayed가 적절.
det.analysis:
✅ ① suddenly(갑자기): 버스가 갑자기 멈춤
✅ ② nervous(불안한): 기차를 놓칠까 걱정
✅ ③ worrying(걱정하는): 계속 걱정함
❌ ④ advanced(앞당겨진) → delayed(지연된): 안도의 맥락

det.korean: ② enthusiasm(열정) → hesitation(망설임): Without hesitation(망설임 없이)이 급히 택시를 탄 맥락에 적절. enthusiasm은 의미 부적합.
det.analysis:
✅ ① mechanical(기계적인): 기계 고장
❌ ② enthusiasm(열정) → hesitation(망설임): without hesitation = 주저 없이
✅ ③ settled(자리 잡은): 좌석에 앉음
✅ ④ relief(안도): 안도의 한숨

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 기차가 지연되어 무사히 탑승한 후 안도의 긴 한숨(a long breath of relief)을 내쉬었다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① a long breath of relief(안도의 긴 한숨): 걱정 해소 후 안도 ←정답
❌ ② a loud cry of anger(분노의 큰 소리): 반대 감정
❌ ③ a deep sigh of regret(후회의 깊은 한숨): 후회할 이유 없음
❌ ④ a sharp scream of fear(공포의 날카로운 비명): 반대 감정
det.tip: let out a breath of relief = 안도의 한숨을 내쉬다

questions.stem: 다음 ①~④ 중, 어법상 오류가 있는 문장은?

det.korean: ③ taked → took: take의 과거형은 took(불규칙 변화)이다. taked는 존재하지 않는 형태.
det.analysis:
✅ ① Daniel was on his way to the train station for a business trip. (다니엘은 출장을 위해 기차역으로 가는 중이었다.) — 정상 문장
✅ ② He was riding a bus when it suddenly stopped. (그가 버스를 타고 있을 때 갑자기 멈췄다.) — 과거진행 + when + 과거 정상
❌ ③ Without hesitation, he got off the bus and taked a taxi to the station. (주저 없이 버스에서 내려 택시를 탔다.) — taked → took: take-took-taken 불규칙 동사
✅ ④ Once he settled into his seat, he let out a long breath of relief. (좌석에 자리 잡자 안도의 긴 한숨을 내쉬었다.) — 정상 문장
